item.title: Levada do Barreiro (PR4): now open with restrictions (see IFCN's note)
item.description: Levada do Barreiro (PR4) changed from closed to open with restrictions (see IFCN's note) on IFCN's official trail-warnings list. IFCN's note: Passable route - a signposted connection to Ribeira das Cales is available, next to the Interpretation Center of the Ecological Park of Funchal. The current version of the route, between Poço da Neve (beginning of PR4), Levada do Barreiro and Ribeira das Cales, is fully marked in both directions.
